extraction.Name: Joseph Emery
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I thought there was no use.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Do you still have the land? Yes.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I have paid all the taxes except the year 1928 and I expect to pay them.
extraction.Occupation/Income: I work in a garage here in town
extraction.NOTES: Supports himself and mother; not married; land is leased for 1/3 of the crop on the farm land and $125 for the remainder per year; patent was delivered at Burke by a Mr. Slaughter where it had been left by some Government officials; no mortgage or other lien on land; did not ask for patent; satisfied to have patent in fee for the present; document notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 2, 1929; document page/number 979
